title: Change your plan
text:
# Change your plan
Admins can upgrade at any time under Settings > Billing. The new limits apply right away.
Downgrades take effect at the next renewal. Before you downgrade, make sure you are within the lower plan's limits, such as 2 bank feeds on Starter.
Plan prices per seat per year: Starter $12, Professional $25, Enterprise $40.

title: Export all your data
text:
# Export all your data
Admins can export all organization data from Settings > Data > Export. You get a ZIP with one CSV per record type.
Exports are usually ready within an hour. You will get an email with a download link that expires in 7 days.

title: How new versions roll out
text:
# How new versions roll out
InvoicePilot uses version numbers of the form major.minor.patch, for example 2.3.1.
| Release type | Example | How you get it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Major or minor | 2.2.0 to 2.3.0 | Your account owner chooses when to upgrade, from Settings > Subscription > Upgrade |
| Patch | 2.3.0 to 2.3.1 | Rolled out automatically to every organization on that line. No action needed |
Upgrades between minor versions are free on every plan.

title: Compare plans
text:
# Compare plans
All plans include every feature: invoicing, expenses, estimates, recurring invoices, multi-currency, client portal, bank reconciliation, reports, and the API. Plans differ in limits and extras.
## List price

| --- | --- |
| Starter | $12 |
| Professional | $25 |
| Enterprise | $40 |

title: Renewals and license expiry
text:
# Renewals and license expiry
Every license runs for 12 months from its order date. You can see each license's expiry date under Settings > Subscription.
Licenses renew for another 12 months when you place a Renewal order. We email the account owner 60, 30, and 7 days before expiry.
If a license expires, users on those seats lose sign-in access. Data is kept for 90 days.

title: User roles and the audit log
text:
# User roles and the audit log
| Role | Can do |
| --- | --- |
| Admin | Everything, including users and billing |
| Accountant | All transactions and reports, no user management |
| Staff | Create invoices, estimates, and expenses |
| Read-only | View only |
Enterprise organizations can build custom roles and see an audit log of every change, kept for 13 months.

title: Seats and adding seats
text:
# Seats and adding seats
InvoicePilot is billed per seat per year. One seat lets one user sign in.
## Adding seats
Account owners can add seats from Settings > Subscription > Add Seats. Added seats are billed at the plan's full per-seat price and start their own 12-month term from the day you add them. They are not prorated.
## Removing seats
Seats can be reduced at renewal. Unused seats are not refunded mid-term.

title: Security overview
text:
# Security overview
InvoicePilot encrypts data in transit with TLS 1.2 or later and at rest with AES-256.
- Two-step verification for every user
- SOC 2 Type II report available on request
- Data hosted in the US and the EU
- Audit log on Enterprise (13 months)
Single sign-on (SAML) is not available today.

title: Single sign-on (SSO) and SAML
text:
# Single sign-on (SSO) and SAML
InvoicePilot does not support SSO or SAML sign-in on any plan today.
Users sign in with email and password, and you can require two-factor authentication for everyone under Settings > Security.
If SSO is important to you, tell your account manager so your request is counted.

title: Authentication
text:
# Authentication
Create an API key under Settings > Developer > API Keys. Send it as a bearer token.
```
curl https://api.invoicepilot.example/v2/invoices \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ip_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```
Keys start with ip_live_ for production and ip_test_ for the sandbox. Keys can be scoped to read-only.

title: Concurrency limits
text:
# Concurrency limits
Besides the per-minute rate limit, each API key can have at most 10 requests in flight at once.
An 11th parallel request gets HTTP 429 with IP-4291 and a Retry-After header. This is different from IP-4290, which means the per-minute limit was reached.
The concurrency limit is the same on every plan. Per-minute limits are 60, 300, or 1,000 by plan.

title: Error subcodes
text:
# Error subcodes
Some errors have a more specific subcode. The HTTP status is the same as the main code on Error codes.
| HTTP | Code | Meaning | Retry? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 404 | IP-4041 | The resource exists but belongs to another organization | No |
| 409 | IP-4091 | A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed | Yes, after 1 second |
| 422 | IP-4221 | Line item validation failed (quantity, rate, or tax) | No |
| 422 | IP-4222 | The currency is not enabled for this organization | No |
| 422 | IP-4223 | The customer is archived | No |
| 422 | IP-4224 | The invoice is void and cannot be changed | No |
| 422 | IP-4225 | The estimate is not accepted, so it cannot be converted | No |
| 422 | IP-4226 | Webhook URL must use HTTPS | No |
| 429 | IP-4291 | Too many concurrent requests (more than 10 in flight per key) | Yes, after Retry-After |
| 503 | IP-5031 | Payment processor unavailable | Yes, with backoff |
> Note: Older integrations that only check the main code keep working: IP-4221 to IP-4226 are all HTTP 422 validation errors.

title: Error codes
text:
# Error codes
Errors return JSON with an HTTP status, a code, and a message.
```
{
  "error": {
    "code": "IP-4220",
    "message": "line_items[3].quantity must be greater than 0"
  }
}
```
| HTTP | Code | Meaning | Retry? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 400 | IP-4000 | Malformed request or invalid JSON | No |
| 401 | IP-4010 | Missing or invalid API key | No |
| 403 | IP-4030 | Key lacks permission, or the limit for your plan is reached | No |
| 404 | IP-4040 | Resource not found | No |
| 409 | IP-4090 | Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request body | No |
| 422 | IP-4220 | Validation failed; see message | No |
| 429 | IP-4290 | Rate limit exceeded; wait for Retry-After | Yes |
| 500 | IP-5000 | Internal error | Yes, with backoff |
| 503 | IP-5030 | Bank feed provider unavailable | Yes, with backoff |
## Idempotency
Send an Idempotency-Key header on POST requests. Retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of creating a duplicate. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

text:

title: Pagination (v2)
text:
# Pagination (v2)
List endpoints in v2 return up to 100 items and a next_cursor. Pass it back as ?cursor= to get the next page. When next_cursor is null you have reached the end.
```
GET /v2/invoices?limit=100
{
  "data": [...],
  "next_cursor": "eyJpZCI6IjEyMzQ1In0"
}
```

title: API quickstart
text:
# API quickstart
The InvoicePilot API is the recommended way to integrate with InvoicePilot. All endpoints live under https://api.invoicepilot.example/v1.
```
curl https://api.invoicepilot.example/v1/invoices?page=1&per_page=50 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```
Use page and per_page to page through results. The maximum per_page is 200.

title: Rate limits
text:
# Rate limits
Rate limits are per organization, counted per minute.
| Plan | Requests per minute |
| --- | --- |
| Starter | 60 |
| Professional | 300 |
| Enterprise | 1,000 |
## Headers
Every v2 response includes:
- X-RateLimit-Limit: your limit per minute
- X-RateLimit-Remaining: requests left in this window
- X-RateLimit-Reset: Unix time when the window resets
When you go over, you get HTTP 429 with error code IP-4290 and a Retry-After header in seconds.
Note: in 2.2.0 these headers were missing (BUG-2200-02). Fixed in 2.3.0.
## Need more?
Higher limits come with a higher plan. Enterprise customers can ask their CSM about a custom limit.

title: Troubleshooting: duplicate payments from API retries
text:
# Troubleshooting: duplicate payments from API retries
Retries of POST /v2/payments with the same Idempotency-Key created duplicate payments. Other endpoints were not affected.
This is BUG-2210-02 (High). It affected 2.2.1. It was fixed in 2.3.0.
## What to do
- On 2.2.1, check GET /v2/payments for an existing payment before retrying.
- Delete duplicates with DELETE /v2/payments/{payment_id}; the invoice reopens.
- Fixed in 2.3.0. Idempotency-Key now works on every POST endpoint.

title: Migrate from API v1 to v2
text:
# Migrate from API v1 to v2
| Change | v1 | v2 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base path | /v1 | /v2 |
| Pagination | ?page=2&per_page=50 | ?cursor=...&limit=100 |
| Errors | Plain text message | JSON with IP- error codes |
| Rate limit headers | None | X-RateLimit-* (from 2.3.0) |
| Idempotency | Not supported | Idempotency-Key header |
1. Create a new v2 key or reuse your v1 key; both work.
2. Switch list calls to cursor pagination.
3. Update error handling to read error.code.
4. Add Idempotency-Key to POST calls so retries are safe.
There is no shutoff date for v1 yet. We will give at least 12 months' notice.

title: Sandbox environment
text:
# Sandbox environment
The sandbox is a separate copy of InvoicePilot for testing. Use keys that start with ip_test_.
- Base URL: https://sandbox.api.invoicepilot.example/v2
- Sandbox data is reset on the first day of every month
- Bank feeds in the sandbox use a fake bank called Test Bank with sample transactions
- Rate limits in the sandbox are 60 requests per minute on every plan
- Webhooks fire in the sandbox too

title: Node.js SDK
Python SDK
text:
# Python SDK
Install with pip install invoicepilot. The current version is 3.2.0 and it supports Python 3.9 and later.
```
from invoicepilot import Client

client = Client(api_key="ip_live_xxxx", max_retries=2)
inv = client.invoices.create(customer_id="cus_8812", currency="EUR",
                             line_items=[{"description": "Consulting", "quantity": 10, "rate": 150}],
                             idempotency_key="7f9c2e1a")
client.invoices.send(inv.id)
```
| Method | API call |
| --- | --- |
| client.invoices.create(...) | POST /v2/invoices |
| client.invoices.send(invoice_id) | POST /v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/send |
| client.invoices.void(invoice_id, reason=...) | POST /v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/void |
| client.payments.create(...) | POST /v2/payments |
| client.payments.delete(payment_id) | DELETE /v2/payments/{payment_id} |
| client.customers.get_statement(customer_id, format="json") | GET /v2/customers/{customer_id}/statements |
| client.webhooks.verify_signature(payload, signature, timestamp, secret) | Checks X-InvoicePilot-Signature locally |
## Retries
The SDK retries IP-4290, IP-4291, IP-5000, and IP-5030 automatically with backoff, up to max_retries times (default 2). It never retries 4xx validation errors.
List methods such as client.invoices.list() follow next_cursor for you. Use auto_paginate=False to get one page.

title: Webhook event types
text:
# Webhook event types
Every event has an id starting with evt_, a type, created_at in UTC, and a data object.
| Event type | Sent when |
| --- | --- |
| invoice.created | An invoice was created (draft or sent) |
| invoice.sent | An invoice was emailed or marked as sent |
| invoice.viewed | The client opened the invoice in the portal |
| invoice.partially_paid | A payment covered part of the invoice |
| invoice.paid | The invoice balance reached zero |
| invoice.overdue | The due date passed with a balance left |
| invoice.voided | The invoice was voided |
| payment.created | A payment was recorded, including portal payments |
| payment.deleted | A payment was deleted and its invoices reopened |
| customer.created | A customer was created |
| customer.updated | A customer's details changed |
| estimate.accepted | The client accepted an estimate |
| estimate.declined | The client declined an estimate |
| recurring_invoice.generated | A recurring profile generated an invoice |
| bank_transaction.matched | A bank transaction was matched, by auto-match or a person |
```
{
  "id": "evt_1Q2w3E4r",
  "type": "invoice.paid",
  "created_at": "2026-07-02T14:05:11Z",
  "data": {"invoice_id": "inv_7731", "amount_paid": 1500.00, "currency": "EUR"}
}
```
> Note: invoice.paid is not sent for voided invoices. Listen for invoice.voided instead.

title: Webhook retries and failures
text:
# Webhook retries and failures
Your endpoint must return a 2xx status within 10 seconds. Anything else counts as a failure.
## Retry schedule
Failed deliveries are retried up to 8 times over 24 hours with exponential backoff: after 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, 4 hours, 8 hours, and 8 hours.
## Disabled endpoints
If every delivery to an endpoint fails for 3 days, the endpoint is disabled and admins get an email. Re-enable it under Settings > Developer > Webhooks.
Deliveries can arrive more than once and out of order. Use the event id to ignore duplicates.

title: Verify webhook signatures
text:
# Verify webhook signatures
Every webhook request has two headers. Check both before trusting the body.
| Header | Contains |
| --- | --- |
| X-InvoicePilot-Signature | HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + '.' + raw body, hex-encoded, using your whsec_ secret |
| X-InvoicePilot-Timestamp | Unix time the request was signed |
Reject requests whose timestamp is more than 5 minutes old. This stops replay attacks.
```
import hmac, hashlib

signed = f"{timestamp}.{raw_body}".encode()
expected = hmac.new(secret.encode(), signed, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
ok = hmac.compare_digest(expected, signature_header)
```
The Python SDK does this for you: client.webhooks.verify_signature(payload, signature, timestamp, secret).

title: Webhooks overview
text:
# Webhooks overview
Webhooks send an HTTPS POST to your endpoint when something happens in InvoicePilot, so you do not have to poll the API.
| Plan | Webhook endpoints |
| --- | --- |
| Starter | Not available |
| Professional | 5 |
| Enterprise | 25 |
## Set up an endpoint
1. Go to Settings > Developer > Webhooks, or call POST /v2/webhook_endpoints.
2. Enter an HTTPS URL. Plain HTTP URLs are rejected with IP-4226.
3. Choose the events to subscribe to.
4. Copy the signing secret. It starts with whsec_ and is shown once.
Webhooks became generally available on 2026-06-15 for API v2.

title: How auto-match decides
text:
# How auto-match decides
Auto-match pairs a bank transaction with an invoice or expense when the amount matches exactly and the dates are within 7 days.
If several invoices match, auto-match suggests them instead of matching, and you choose.
On 2.3.1, foreign-currency amounts are not converted before they are compared (BUG-2310-01). Use manual matching for those transactions.

title: Bank reconciliation auto-match
text:
# Bank reconciliation auto-match
Added in 2.3.0. Auto-match compares incoming bank transactions with recorded invoices and expenses and suggests matches.
## How matching works
- Amount must match exactly
- Date must be within 5 days
- Payee or reference text raises confidence
Auto-match runs the first time you open Bank Reconciliation after upgrading. Review suggested matches before confirming them in bulk.
> Known issue: On 2.3.1, auto-match does not convert foreign-currency amounts (BUG-2310-01, Critical). See Multi-currency accounts and bank reconciliation.

title: Bank feeds: frequently asked questions
text:
# Bank feeds: frequently asked questions
### How often do bank feeds update?
Bank feeds sync once a day, usually overnight. Transactions from today will appear tomorrow.
### Can I connect a credit card?
Yes. Credit cards connect the same way as bank accounts.
### Is my bank login stored?
No. The connection uses a read-only token from your bank. InvoicePilot never sees your password.

title: How often bank feeds sync
text:
# How often bank feeds sync
Since 2.3.0, connected bank feeds sync every 4 hours. Before 2.3.0 they synced once a day.
Click Refresh Feed on any bank account to sync on demand, up to 5 times per day.

title: Connect a bank feed
text:
# Connect a bank feed
1. Go to Banking > Add Bank Account.
2. Search for your bank and sign in through the secure connection.
3. Pick which accounts to connect.
4. Choose how far back to import, up to 90 days.
| Plan | Connected bank feeds |
| --- | --- |
| Starter | 2 |
| Professional | 10 |
| Enterprise | Unlimited |

title: Disconnect a bank feed
text:
# Disconnect a bank feed
Go to Banking > Accounts, open the account, and click Disconnect feed. Imported transactions stay.
Disconnecting frees a slot under your plan's limit: 2 feeds on Starter, 10 on Professional, unlimited on Enterprise.

title: Reconcile transactions manually
text:
# Reconcile transactions manually
Manual reconciliation has been available since 2.0.0 and is still the fallback when auto-match cannot find a match.
1. Go to Banking and open the account.
2. Click an uncategorized transaction.
3. Choose Match to pick an existing invoice or expense, or Categorize to record a new one.
4. When the statement balance and InvoicePilot balance agree, click Finish Reconciliation.

title: Review and confirm suggested matches
text:
# Review and confirm suggested matches
Suggested matches show a confidence label: High, Medium, or Low.
- High: amount, date, and reference all match
- Medium: amount and date match
- Low: amount matches only
You can confirm all High matches in one click. Medium and Low matches should be checked one at a time.
Undo a confirmed match from the transaction's history within 30 days.

title: Client Portal 2.0 overview
text:
# Client Portal 2.0 overview
Version 2.2.0 introduced Client Portal 2.0, a single self-serve page where your clients can:
- View their full invoice history
- Download statements
- Pay online
- Accept or decline estimates
Existing portal links from earlier versions keep working with no changes.

title: Customer statements
text:
# Customer statements
A statement lists a customer's invoices, payments, and balance for a date range.
## For one customer
Open the customer and click Statement. Download as PDF or email it. Clients can also download their own statements from the portal.
## For many customers
There is no bulk statement export in the app today. Two options:
- Use the custom report builder (2.3.0+) with the Customer Balance report and export to XLSX.
- Use API v2: GET /v2/customers/{customer_id}/statements for each customer.

title: Brand your client portal
text:
# Brand your client portal
Add your logo and accent color so the portal matches your brand.
Go to Settings > Client Portal > Branding.
> Note: Portal branding is available on Professional and Enterprise. Starter portals use the default InvoicePilot look.

title: Troubleshooting: client can't pay the rest of an invoice
text:
# Troubleshooting: client can't pay the rest of an invoice
Clients could not pay the rest of a partially paid invoice from the client portal because the Pay now button was hidden.
This is BUG-2210-01 (High). It affected 2.2.1. It was fixed in 2.3.0.
## What to do
- On 2.2.1, send the client a payment link from the invoice: More > Copy payment link.
- Fixed in 2.3.0.

title: Payment methods in the client portal
text:
# Payment methods in the client portal
Clients can pay by card or bank transfer (ACH in the US, SEPA in the EU).
Card payments are settled to your bank account in 2 business days. Bank transfers take 3 to 5 business days.
Portal payments are created as payments automatically and trigger the payment.created webhook.

title: Troubleshooting: client portal login loop on Safari
text:
# Troubleshooting: client portal login loop on Safari
BUG-2200-01: Safari users were redirected back to the login page after successful authentication due to a cookie SameSite misconfiguration.
This affected 2.2.0 and was fixed in a hotfix within 2.2.0. No action needed.
If a client still sees the loop, ask them to clear cookies for portal.invoicepilot.example and sign in again.

title: API v1 shutdown date?
author: integrator_pat
text:
# API v1 shutdown date?
Heard v1 shuts down at the end of 2026. Anyone confirm?
Reply: docs still say no shutoff date and 12 months' notice. I'd ignore the rumor.

title: Is API v1 going away?
author: dev_priyanka
text:
# Is API v1 going away?
Our integration still uses v1 and it works fine after the 2.2.0 update. Docs say v1 is legacy but there's no shutdown date.

title: IP-4223 creating invoice
author: integrator_pat
text:
# IP-4223 creating invoice
IP-4223 means the customer is archived. Unarchive it first.

title: Audit log history
author: it_admin_ravi
text:
# Audit log history
Enterprise audit log keeps 13 months. We export it monthly for longer retention.

title: Auto-match and GBP
author: finops_dan
text:
# Auto-match and GBP
Following up on my EUR post. Same with GBP. We just leave foreign accounts on manual matching.
Someone said the fix is coming in 2.4.0 but I haven't seen that anywhere official.

title: How often do feeds sync?
author: newbie_ella
text:
# How often do feeds sync?
Is it once a day? The FAQ says that.
Reply: every 4 hours since 2.3.0. The FAQ is old.

title: Tip: bulk-sending invoices at month end
author: ledger_lucy
text:
# Tip: bulk-sending invoices at month end
We send about 300 invoices at month end. Bulk actions only let you pick 50 at a time, so filter by customer group and do it in batches of 50.
Also, do the payment reminders the same way. Works fine for us.

title: Bulk void limit
author: ledger_lucy
text:
# Bulk void limit
Bulk void also caps at 50 for us. Do it in batches.
Reply: mine lets me pick 100.

title: Classic API rate limit
author: classic_carol
text:
# Classic API rate limit
Classic API is 30 requests a minute for everyone. Painful for our sync.

title: Credit note or void?
author: studio_mei
text:
# Credit note or void?
Void if the invoice was a mistake. Credit note if the client is owed something back. Credit notes show on statements.

title: IP-4222 on EUR invoice
author: eu_freelancer
text:
# IP-4222 on EUR invoice
Got IP-4222 creating an EUR invoice. Had to enable EUR under Settings > Currencies.

title: Extra empty page at the end of every list call
author: dev_priyanka
text:
# Extra empty page at the end of every list call
On 2.2.0 the last page still has a next_cursor and the next call returns nothing. Annoying but harmless.
Reply: fixed in 2.2.1, next_cursor is null now.

title: Custom roles on Professional?
author: ops_rahul
text:
# Custom roles on Professional?
Pretty sure we had custom roles on Professional. Can't find them now.
Reply: custom roles are Enterprise only. You might be thinking of the 4 built-in roles.

title: Blank dashboard
author: big_ledger
text:
# Blank dashboard
Dashboard is blank for us, we have ~800 contacts. Support says BUG-2000-02 and a fix is rolling out.

title: API created two payments
author: erp_sam
text:
# API created two payments
Our retry logic created duplicate payments even with an Idempotency-Key. Support says BUG-2210-02 on 2.2.1.
We now check GET /v2/payments before retrying.

title: Can't convert estimate via API
author: erp_sam
text:
# Can't convert estimate via API
POST /v2/estimates/{estimate_id}/convert gives IP-4225. The estimate has to be accepted first.

title: Weekend invoices used Friday's rate
author: eu_freelancer
text:
# Weekend invoices used Friday's rate
Noticed on 2.0.0 that invoices made on Sunday used Friday's EUR rate. Support says BUG-2000-03, fixed in 2.0.1.

title: UK date format in expense import
author: uk_books
text:
# UK date format in expense import
Import fails with our DD/MM/YYYY dates. Converting to YYYY-MM-DD in Excel first works.

title: IP-4091 what is it
author: nodedev_kim
text:
# IP-4091 what is it
IP-4091 means the first request with that key is still running. Wait a second and retry, the SDK does it.

title: IP-4090 on retry
author: erp_sam
text:
# IP-4090 on retry
We got IP-4090 because our retry changed the body (new timestamp field) but kept the same Idempotency-Key. Keep the body identical.

title: IP-4290 vs IP-4291?
author: api_amir
text:
# IP-4290 vs IP-4291?
We started getting IP-4291 after moving our sync job to 20 workers. Turns out it's the concurrency limit (10 in flight), not the per-minute limit, which is IP-4290.
Dropped to 8 workers and it's gone.

title: Where did late fees go after the upgrade?
author: classic_carol
text:
# Where did late fees go after the upgrade?
We used automatic late fees in Classic and they're gone in 2.0.0.
Reply: they weren't carried over. We add a line item now.

title: Mileage in kilometers
author: eu_freelancer
text:
# Mileage in kilometers
You can set the mileage rate per km in Settings > Expenses.

title: Multi-currency on Starter?
author: smallbiz_joe
text:
# Multi-currency on Starter?
Yes, multi-currency works on Starter. Settings > Currencies.

title: Client can't pay the rest
author: agency_ana
text:
# Client can't pay the rest
After a partial payment the portal hides Pay now. We send the payment link by hand. BUG-2210-01 apparently.

title: Long invoices cut off in the PDF
author: agency_ana
text:
# Long invoices cut off in the PDF
Our 40-line invoices only show the first page in the PDF. Known bug BUG-2310-02.
We send the link instead. Clients see everything online.

title: ACH in the portal
author: smallbiz_joe
text:
# ACH in the portal
Clients can pay by ACH from the portal now. Takes 3-5 business days to land.

title: Does the Python SDK retry on its own?
author: py_marco
text:
# Does the Python SDK retry on its own?
Yes. client = Client(max_retries=3) and it retries 429, 500 and 503. It won't retry IP-4220 validation errors.

title: No X-RateLimit headers?
author: api_amir
text:
# No X-RateLimit headers?
On 2.2.0 there are no X-RateLimit-Remaining headers in v2 responses. Support says BUG-2200-02.

title: Receipt scanning reads nothing
author: roadwarrior_tom
text:
# Receipt scanning reads nothing
Landscape photos come out sideways and the amount is blank. Take them in portrait until the fix (BUG-2100-03).

title: Auto-match ignoring our EUR account?
author: finops_dan
text:
# Auto-match ignoring our EUR account?
Since 2.3.1 our EUR feed barely matches anything. Support says it's a known bug. We switched the EUR account to manual matching for now and it's fine, just slower.
Reply: same here with GBP. Didn't hear when the fix is coming.

title: Clients got reminders twice
author: studio_mei
text:
# Clients got reminders twice
Two identical reminders went out last night. Support linked it to BUG-2100-04. Our window was 23:00 to 01:00 UTC.

title: Report builder times out
author: cfo_greta
text:
# Report builder times out
5-year revenue report times out. BUG-2300-01. Split into 3-year chunks and combine in Excel.

title: Sandbox data disappeared
author: qa_lin
text:
# Sandbox data disappeared
All our sandbox test data was gone this morning.
Reply: the sandbox resets on the first of every month.

title: Are added seats prorated?
author: ops_rahul
text:
# Are added seats prorated?
No, added seats are full price for their own 12-month term. Plan ahead.

title: SSO when?
author: it_admin_ravi
text:
# SSO when?
We need SAML. Sales said 'soon'. Nothing on the roadmap page.
Reply: same. No date anywhere.

title: Webhooks on Starter?
author: smallbiz_joe
text:
# Webhooks on Starter?
Can't find the webhooks settings on Starter. Is it a bug?
Reply: it's Professional and Enterprise only.

title: Getting statements as JSON
author: erp_sam
text:
# Getting statements as JSON
GET /v2/customers/{customer_id}/statements?format=json works. Saves us parsing PDFs.

title: Changing tax rate changed old invoices?
author: newbie_ella
text:
# Changing tax rate changed old invoices?
I was worried, but no, old invoices keep their rate. Only new ones use the new rate.

title: Webhook endpoint disabled itself
author: nodedev_kim
text:
# Webhook endpoint disabled itself
Our endpoint was down for a long weekend and InvoicePilot disabled it. It's after 3 days of failures. Re-enable in settings.

title: How many webhook retries?
author: py_marco
text:
# How many webhook retries?
Webhooks retry 5 times then give up.
Reply: I think they changed it recently.

title: Webhook signature never matches
author: nodedev_kim
text:
# Webhook signature never matches
Spent a day on this. You have to sign timestamp + '.' + the RAW body, not the parsed JSON re-serialized.
Also use X-InvoicePilot-Timestamp, not your server time.

title: Date picker starts on Sunday
author: eu_freelancer
text:
# Date picker starts on Sunday
Report date picker ignores our Monday locale. BUG-2310-03, cosmetic only.

title: Convert an estimate to an invoice
text:
# Convert an estimate to an invoice
Open an accepted estimate and click Convert to Invoice. All line items, taxes, and notes carry over.
You can convert one estimate into several invoices for staged billing, for example 50% up front and 50% on completion.

title: Create and send an estimate
text:
# Create and send an estimate
Estimates, also called quotes, let you send a price before you do the work.
1. Go to Sales > Estimates > New.
2. Add the customer and line items.
3. Set an expiry date.
4. Send it.
Clients can accept or decline from the email or the client portal.

title: Estimate expiry dates
text:
# Estimate expiry dates
Estimates can have an expiry date. After it passes, the client can no longer accept the estimate from the portal.
You can extend an expired estimate by editing the expiry date and sending it again.

title: Manage expense categories
text:
# Manage expense categories
Go to Settings > Expense Categories to add, rename, or archive categories.
To move many expenses at once, select them in the expenses list and click Change Category. This bulk action was added in 2.1.0.

title: Import expenses from CSV
text:
# Import expenses from CSV
Go to Expenses > Import and upload a CSV with date, vendor, amount, currency, and category columns.
Since 2.2.1, dates can be YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY. Before that, only YYYY-MM-DD worked (BUG-2110-02).
Up to 2,000 rows per file.

title: Troubleshooting: expense CSV import fails on dates
text:
# Troubleshooting: expense CSV import fails on dates
Importing expenses from CSV failed for files with dates written as DD/MM/YYYY.
This is BUG-2110-02 (Medium). It affected 2.1.1. It was fixed in 2.2.1.
## What to do
- On 2.1.1 to 2.2.0, convert dates to YYYY-MM-DD before importing.
- Since 2.2.1, DD/MM/YYYY is accepted.

title: Mileage expenses
text:
# Mileage expenses
Record mileage as an expense: enter the distance and InvoicePilot multiplies it by your mileage rate.
Set the rate under Settings > Expenses. Rates can be per mile or per kilometer.

title: Troubleshooting: scanned receipt is sideways
text:
# Troubleshooting: scanned receipt is sideways
Receipts photographed in landscape were rotated 90 degrees before OCR, so the amount was often missed.
This is BUG-2100-03 (Low). It affected 2.1.0. It was fixed in 2.1.1.
## What to do
- Retake the photo in portrait mode, or update to 2.1.1.
- You can always type the amount by hand.

title: Scan receipts
text:
# Scan receipts
Added in 2.1.0. Take a photo of a receipt in the mobile app, or upload one, and InvoicePilot extracts the vendor, date, and amount.
## Accuracy
Typed and printed receipts scan reliably. Always check the extracted amount before saving.
> Known issue: BUG-2100-01 (Won't Fix): OCR accuracy on handwritten receipts is below 40%; typed/printed receipts are unaffected. Documented as a known limitation.

title: Record an expense
text:
# Record an expense
1. Go to Purchases > Expenses > New.
2. Enter date, amount, vendor, and category.
3. Optionally mark it billable and link it to a customer.
4. Attach a receipt image or PDF.
Since 2.1.0 you can bulk-reassign expense categories from the expenses list.

title: Create your organization
text:
# Create your organization
Your organization holds your company profile, base currency, fiscal year, and users.
1. Sign up at app.invoicepilot.example and verify your email.
2. Enter your company name, country, and industry.
3. Choose your base currency. This cannot be changed after your first transaction.
4. Set your fiscal year start month.
5. Choose a plan: Starter, Professional, or Enterprise.
> Note: Your base currency is the currency your reports are shown in. To bill in other currencies, enable multi-currency later under Settings > Currencies.

title: Understanding the dashboard
text:
# Understanding the dashboard
The dashboard gives an at-a-glance view of revenue, outstanding invoices, and expense trends.
## Widgets
- Total receivables, split into current and overdue
- Income and expense chart for the last 12 months
- Top 5 expense categories
- Cash flow by bank account
## Large accounts
In early 2.0.0 builds, accounts with more than 500 contacts saw a blank dashboard (BUG-2000-02). This was fixed within version 2.0.0.

title: Invite users and assign seats
text:
# Invite users and assign seats
Each person who signs in to InvoicePilot uses one seat. You can invite as many users as you have seats.
1. Go to Settings > Users.
2. Click Invite User and enter their email.
3. Pick a role: Admin, Accountant, Staff, or Read-only.
4. Click Send Invite. The invite link expires after 7 days.
If you run out of seats, an account owner can buy more from Settings > Subscription > Add Seats.
> Note: Custom roles beyond the four built-in roles are available on the Enterprise plan only.

title: Finding your way around
text:
# Finding your way around
Version 2.0.0 introduced a redesigned navigation. The left sidebar holds Dashboard, Sales (Invoices, Estimates, Recurring Invoices, Customers), Purchases (Expenses), Banking, Reports, and Settings.
Organization preferences such as currencies, taxes, invoice templates, and users all live under Settings.

title: Welcome to InvoicePilot
text:
# Welcome to InvoicePilot
InvoicePilot is online invoicing and accounting software for small and mid-sized businesses. You can send invoices, track expenses, reconcile bank accounts, and give clients a self-serve portal.
## What you can do
- Create and send invoices in any supported currency
- Schedule recurring invoices that generate and send automatically
- Record expenses and scan receipts
- Send estimates and convert them to invoices
- Connect bank feeds and reconcile transactions
- Build custom reports and export them
- Integrate with other systems through the REST API
## Current version
The current version is 2.3.1 "Aurora Patch 1", released 2026-08-14. See Version history for every release.

title: Troubleshooting: tax missing on an old draft
text:
# Troubleshooting: tax missing on an old draft
Draft invoices that used a tax rate archived later showed an empty tax field instead of the archived rate.
This is BUG-2010-01 (Low). It affected 2.0.1. It was fixed in 2.1.0.
## What to do
- Open the draft and pick the tax rate again.
- Fixed in 2.1.0.

title: Bulk invoice actions
text:
# Bulk invoice actions
From the Invoices list you can select several invoices and act on all of them at once.
## Supported actions
- Send
- Send payment reminder
- Void
- Mark as sent
- Export as PDF (zipped)
## Limits
You can select up to 100 invoices per bulk action. To act on more, filter the list and repeat.
Bulk actions were added in version 2.2.0.

title: Troubleshooting: reminders sent for voided invoices
text:
# Troubleshooting: reminders sent for voided invoices
Invoices voided with a bulk action kept their scheduled payment reminders, so clients got reminders for void invoices.
This is BUG-2200-03 (Medium). It affected 2.2.0. It was fixed in 2.2.1.
## What to do
- On 2.2.0, cancel reminders by hand after a bulk void: open each client > Reminders.
- Since 2.2.1, a bulk void cancels reminders automatically.

title: Create and send an invoice
text:
# Create and send an invoice
1. Go to Sales > Invoices and click New Invoice.
2. Pick a customer. Their currency and payment terms fill in automatically.
3. Add line items with quantity, rate, and tax.
4. Choose a template.
5. Click Save and Send to email it, or Save as Draft.
Invoice numbers follow your prefix and sequence, set under Settings > Invoices. The default is INV-000001.
Search covers invoice numbers and line-item descriptions.

title: Credit notes
text:
# Credit notes
A credit note reduces what a client owes without deleting or voiding an invoice. Credit note numbers start with CN-.
- Apply a credit note to one or more open invoices
- Or keep it as client credit for future invoices
- Credit notes appear on customer statements
Credit notes were added in 2.2.0 and are available on every plan.

title: Duplicate an invoice
text:
# Duplicate an invoice
Open an invoice and click More > Duplicate. The copy is a new draft with today's date and the next number.
To bill the same thing every month, set up a recurring invoice instead.

title: Troubleshooting: clients got the same reminder twice
text:
# Troubleshooting: clients got the same reminder twice
Client-level reminders with a send window that crossed midnight UTC were sent twice.
This is BUG-2100-04 (Medium). It affected 2.1.0. It was fixed in 2.1.1.
## What to do
- Update to 2.1.1; this happens automatically.
- On 2.1.0, set the reminder send window so it does not cross midnight UTC.

title: Export invoices as PDF
text:
# Export invoices as PDF
Open an invoice and click PDF > Download, or select several and use the bulk Export as PDF action.
> Known issue: In 2.3.1, invoices with more than 25 line items export as a single page and drop the remaining lines (BUG-2310-02). See Line items and long invoices for a workaround.

title: Attach files to invoices
text:
# Attach files to invoices
Attach up to 5 files per invoice, each up to 10 MB. Clients can download them from the email or the portal.
Supported formats: PDF, PNG, JPEG, DOCX, XLSX, and CSV.

title: Troubleshooting: gaps in invoice numbers
text:
# Troubleshooting: gaps in invoice numbers
Deleting a draft invoice consumed its number, leaving a gap in the INV- sequence.
This is BUG-2000-04 (Low). It affected 2.0.0. It was fixed in 2.0.1.
## What to do
- Gaps created on 2.0.0 stay in the sequence; numbers are never reused.
- Since 2.0.1, deleting a draft frees its number.
- For auditors, export the Invoice Register report, which lists deleted drafts.

title: Invoice numbering
text:
# Invoice numbering
Invoices are numbered INV-000001, INV-000002, and so on. You can change the prefix and the next number under Settings > Invoices.
Numbers are never reused, even if an invoice is voided.
On 2.0.0, deleting a draft left a gap in the sequence (BUG-2000-04). Since 2.0.1, deleting a draft frees its number.

title: Search invoices
text:
# Search invoices
Use the search bar on the Invoices list. Since 2.0.0, search covers line-item descriptions as well as invoice numbers.
- Search by invoice number: INV-000123
- Search by customer name
- Search by any word in a line-item description
- Filter by status: Draft, Sent, Overdue, Paid, Void

title: Invoice templates
text:
# Invoice templates
Templates control how your invoice PDF looks: layout, fonts, logo, and which fields appear.
| Plan | Templates |
| --- | --- |
| Starter | 3 standard templates |
| Professional | Standard templates plus custom templates |
| Enterprise | Standard templates plus custom templates |
## Creating a custom template
1. Go to Settings > Templates > Invoices.
2. Click New Custom Template and start from a standard one.
3. Edit the header, columns, footer, and colors.
4. Save and set it as default if you like.
Since 2.0.0, invoice PDFs with custom templates render about 2x faster than before.
> Note: Starter customers asking for a custom template need to move to Professional or Enterprise.

title: Do late fees exist in InvoicePilot 2.x?
text:
# Do late fees exist in InvoicePilot 2.x?
Automatic late fees were part of InvoicePilot Classic (1.x). They were not carried over to 2.0.0.
In 2.x, add a late fee as a separate line item or a new invoice. Payment reminders can mention your late-fee terms.

title: Discounts on line items
text:
# Discounts on line items
Each line item can have a discount as a percentage or a fixed amount. Discounts are applied before tax.
To discount the whole invoice, add a discount on every line or add a negative line item.

title: Line items and long invoices
text:
# Line items and long invoices
An invoice can have up to 500 line items. Each line has an item, description, quantity, rate, discount, and tax.
## Long invoices in PDF
> Known issue: BUG-2310-02 (High, Open): Invoices with more than 25 line items export as a single-page PDF, silently dropping remaining line items. Affects 2.3.1.
### Workaround
- Send the invoice by email link instead of attaching the PDF. The online view shows every line.
- Or group related lines so the invoice has 25 line items or fewer.
- The client portal view is not affected.

title: Partial payments
text:
# Partial payments
An invoice can be paid in several parts. Each payment lowers the balance, and the status shows Partially paid until the balance is zero.
Clients can pay the remaining balance from the client portal. On 2.2.1 the Pay now button was hidden for partially paid invoices (BUG-2210-01); this was fixed in 2.3.0.
Payment reminders mention the remaining balance, not the original total.

title: Payment reminders
text:
# Payment reminders
Version 2.1.0 added client-level payment reminders with configurable send windows.
1. Go to Settings > Reminders to set defaults: for example 3 days before due, on the due date, and 7 days after.
2. Pick a send window, such as weekdays 9:00 to 17:00 in the client's timezone.
3. Override per client from the customer's page.
Since 2.2.0 you can also send reminders in bulk from the Invoices list.

title: Record a payment
text:
# Record a payment
Record payments you receive outside the client portal, such as bank transfers or checks.
1. Open the invoice and click Record Payment.
2. Enter the amount, date, and method.
3. Click Save. The invoice status changes to Paid or Partially paid.
Payments made through the client portal are recorded automatically.

title: Refund a payment
text:
# Refund a payment
Refunds are recorded against a payment. The invoice is reopened for the refunded amount.
1. Open the payment from the invoice.
2. Click Refund and enter the amount.
3. Choose whether to issue a credit note instead of reopening the invoice.
Refunds of portal card payments go back to the client's card within 5 to 10 business days.

title: Send invoices by email
text:
# Send invoices by email
When you send an invoice, the client gets an email with a link to view and pay it, plus the PDF attached.
- Edit the default email under Settings > Emails
- Add CC and BCC addresses per client
- See when the client opened the invoice in its activity log
For invoices with more than 25 line items on 2.3.1, send the link rather than relying on the PDF (BUG-2310-02).

title: Add a new tax rate
text:
# Add a new tax rate
1. Go to Settings > Taxes.
2. Click New Tax Rate.
3. Enter a name (for example, NY Sales Tax) and a percentage.
4. Optionally group rates into a tax group, like state plus county.
5. Save. The rate is now available on invoice and estimate line items.
Changing a tax rate only affects new invoices. Existing invoices keep the rate they were created with.

title: Void or delete an invoice
text:
# Void or delete an invoice
Draft invoices can be deleted. Sent invoices cannot be deleted; void them instead so your records stay complete.
1. Open the invoice.
2. Click More > Void.
3. Enter a reason. The reason is kept with the invoice.
Voided invoices stay in reports with a zero balance and show a VOID watermark.

title: Classic API
text:
# Classic API
Classic integrations use API v1 at /v1 with page-based pagination: ?page=2&per_page=50.
Errors are plain text messages with no error codes. Rate limit: 30 requests per minute on every plan.

title: Attachments (Classic)
text:
# Attachments (Classic)
In 1.9.0 you can attach files up to 10 MB.
Emails with attachments over 5 MB can be delayed up to 2 hours (BUG-1900-01, Won't Fix).

title: Bank statements (Classic)
text:
# Bank statements (Classic)
Classic has no live bank feeds. Import a bank statement CSV once a month and match each line by hand.

title: CSV export (Classic)
text:
# CSV export (Classic)
Export invoices, payments, and expenses as CSV from each list.
In 1.8.0 some locales got semicolon separators (BUG-1800-01). Fixed in 1.9.0.

title: Currencies (Classic)
text:
# Currencies (Classic)
Classic supports one currency per organization. To bill a client in another currency, convert the amounts yourself.
Multi-currency invoicing is not available in Classic.

title: Estimates (Classic)
text:
# Estimates (Classic)
Estimates were added in 1.9.0. Clients accept an estimate by replying to the email; there is no portal.

title: Late fees (Classic)
text:
# Late fees (Classic)
Classic can add a late fee to overdue invoices automatically: a fixed amount or a percentage of the subtotal.
Turn it on under Settings > Late Fees. The fee is added 1 day after the due date.
In 1.8.0 the fee was calculated on the total including tax (BUG-1800-02). Fixed in 1.9.0.

title: Moving from Classic to 2.0.0
text:
# Moving from Classic to 2.0.0
1. Your data moves automatically: clients, invoices, payments, expenses, and estimates.
2. Late fee settings do not move, because 2.x has no automatic late fees.
3. Classic plans map to new plans: Solo and Team to Starter or Professional, Business to Enterprise.
4. API v1 keeps working after the move.

title: InvoicePilot Classic (1.x) documentation
text:
# InvoicePilot Classic (1.x) documentation
These pages describe InvoicePilot Classic, versions 1.8.0 and 1.9.0. Classic was replaced by InvoicePilot 2.0.0 in June 2025.
> Note: If you use InvoicePilot today, you are on 2.x. Use the main help center instead.

title: Classic plans
text:
# Classic plans
| Plan | Users | Price per user per year |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Solo | 1 | $9 |
| Team | Up to 10 | $18 |
| Business | Unlimited | $30 |
Classic plans were replaced by Starter, Professional, and Enterprise in 2.0.0.

title: Repeating invoices (Classic)
text:
# Repeating invoices (Classic)
Classic has no automatic recurring invoices. Use Duplicate to copy last month's invoice.
Some users set a calendar reminder to duplicate invoices each month.

title: Reports (Classic)
text:
# Reports (Classic)
Classic has 8 standard reports. Custom reports are not available.
Organizations with more than 5,000 invoices may see reports time out (BUG-1900-02). This was fixed in 2.0.0.

title: Support for Classic
text:
# Support for Classic
Classic is no longer supported since 2.0.0 was released. All Classic organizations were moved to 2.0.0 automatically.

title: Enable multi-currency
text:
# Enable multi-currency
Multi-currency invoicing arrived in 2.0.0. It lets you bill customers in their own currency.
1. Go to Settings > Currencies.
2. Turn on Multi-currency.
3. Add the currencies you need.
4. Set each customer's currency on their profile.
> Note: Existing single-currency organizations are not affected until multi-currency is turned on.

title: Exchange rates
text:
# Exchange rates
InvoicePilot updates exchange rates once a day from a market data provider. You can also enter a rate by hand on any invoice.
Reports convert foreign amounts to your base currency using the rate saved on each transaction.

title: Multi-currency accounts and bank reconciliation
text:
# Multi-currency accounts and bank reconciliation
If your bank feed is in a currency different from your invoices, InvoicePilot must convert amounts before matching.
> Known issue: BUG-2310-01 (Critical, Open): Auto-match in bank reconciliation does not convert foreign-currency transactions before comparing amounts, so multi-currency accounts see most transactions left unmatched. Affects 2.3.1.
### Workaround
- Use manual matching for foreign-currency transactions until a fix ships.
- Base-currency transactions still auto-match normally.
- Do not bulk-confirm suggested matches on multi-currency accounts; review each one.

title: Troubleshooting: weekend invoices used Friday's exchange rate
text:
# Troubleshooting: weekend invoices used Friday's exchange rate
Daily exchange rates were not refreshed on Saturdays and Sundays, so weekend invoices used Friday's rate.
This is BUG-2000-03 (Medium). It affected 2.0.0. It was fixed in 2.0.1.
## What to do
- Update to 2.0.1 or later; this happens automatically.
- To fix an old invoice, edit the exchange rate on the invoice and save it.

title: Zero-decimal currencies (JPY, KRW, and others)
text:
# Zero-decimal currencies (JPY, KRW, and others)
Some currencies, like Japanese yen and Korean won, have no decimal places.
## Rounding fix
BUG-2000-01: Invoices in JPY and other zero-decimal currencies rounded totals incorrectly, overcharging customers by up to 1 unit per line item. It affected 2.0.0 and was fixed in 2.1.0.
If you issued invoices in a zero-decimal currency on 2.0.0, review them for 1-unit overcharges per line item.

title: Pause or stop a recurring invoice
text:
# Pause or stop a recurring invoice
Open the recurring profile and click Pause. No invoices are generated while it is paused.
When you resume, the next invoice goes out on the next scheduled date. Missed dates are not sent.
To stop for good, click Stop. Invoices already sent are not affected.

title: Troubleshooting: recurring preview shows the wrong currency
text:
# Troubleshooting: recurring preview shows the wrong currency
The preview of upcoming recurring invoices showed the base currency symbol for clients billed in another currency. The invoices themselves were correct.
This is BUG-2110-01 (Low). It affected 2.1.1. It was fixed in 2.2.0.
## What to do
- Only the preview was wrong. Generated invoices used the right currency.
- Fixed in 2.2.0.

title: Recurring cadences explained
text:
# Recurring cadences explained
| Cadence | Example |
| --- | --- |
| Daily | Every day at 06:00 |
| Weekly | Every Monday |
| Monthly | The 1st of every month, or the last day of the month |
| Custom | Every 2 weeks, every 3 months, or every N days |
If a monthly schedule falls on a day that does not exist, like February 30, the invoice goes out on the last day of that month.

title: How recurring invoice schedules handle time zones
text:
# How recurring invoice schedules handle time zones
Starting in 2.3.1, recurring invoice schedules are calculated in UTC internally. Send times are still shown in your organization's local time zone.
This change fixed BUG-2100-02, where schedules calculated in local time skipped a cycle when daylight-saving time shifted.
No action is needed. Existing schedules were migrated automatically when 2.3.1 rolled out.

title: Recurring invoices: frequently asked questions
text:
# Recurring invoices: frequently asked questions
### Which time zone do schedules use?
Since 2.3.1, UTC internally. Dates are shown in your local time.
### Can a recurring invoice charge a card automatically?
No. Clients pay from the invoice email or the portal.
### Can I change the amount for one cycle?
Yes. Edit the generated draft before it is sent, or set the profile to create drafts.
### What happens on the 31st in shorter months?
The invoice goes out on the last day of the month.

title: Recurring invoices use your local time zone
text:
# Recurring invoices use your local time zone
Recurring invoice schedules are calculated in your organization's local time zone, set under Settings > Organization.
If you change your organization's time zone, future send dates are recalculated.
We are aware that some customers have reported a missed cycle around daylight-saving changes. We are investigating.

title: Set up recurring invoices
text:
# Set up recurring invoices
Recurring invoices were added in 2.1.0. They generate and send an invoice on a schedule.
1. Go to Sales > Recurring Invoices > New.
2. Choose the customer and line items.
3. Pick a cadence: daily, weekly, monthly, or custom.
4. Set a start date and an optional end date.
5. Choose whether to send automatically or save as draft for review.
Before you confirm, the preview shows the next 3 scheduled send dates.

title: Troubleshooting: a recurring invoice skipped a cycle
text:
# Troubleshooting: a recurring invoice skipped a cycle
Cause: BUG-2100-02, "Recurring invoices skip a cycle across DST changes". Recurring invoice schedules calculated in local time skipped a billing cycle when daylight-saving time shifted, causing missed invoices for some customers.
Affected versions: 2.1.0 through 2.3.0. Fixed in 2.3.1.
## If you are on 2.3.1
The fix is already applied. To recover a missed invoice from before the fix, open the recurring profile and click Create Missed Invoice.
## If you are on an older version
Upgrade to 2.3.x. As a stopgap, avoid schedules that send between 01:00 and 03:00 local time on DST change days.

title: Aged receivables report
text:
# Aged receivables report
Shows what each client owes, grouped by how overdue it is: current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, and over 90 days.
Click a client to see their invoices. Export as PDF or CSV, or XLSX on 2.3.0 and later.

title: Custom report builder
text:
# Custom report builder
Added in 2.3.0. Build a report from any combination of accounts, date ranges, and tags, then save it.
| Plan | Saved custom reports |
| --- | --- |
| Starter | 10 |
| Professional | 100 |
| Enterprise | Unlimited |
In 2.3.1, the report builder got faster for accounts with 10,000+ transactions.
> Known issue: BUG-2300-01 (Open): Reports spanning more than 3 years of transactions time out instead of paginating results.

title: Date picker shows the wrong first day of the week
text:
# Date picker shows the wrong first day of the week
BUG-2310-03 (Low): The date-range picker in the custom report builder always starts weeks on Sunday, ignoring the organization's locale setting.
This is cosmetic. Report data is correct. Type dates directly into the range fields if the calendar is confusing.

title: Troubleshooting: report times out on long date ranges
text:
# Troubleshooting: report times out on long date ranges
BUG-2300-01: Reports spanning more than 3 years of transactions time out instead of paginating results. Status: Open. Affects 2.3.0 and later.
## Workaround
- Split the report into ranges of 3 years or less and combine the exports.
- Or use API v2, which pages through results with a cursor.

title: Export a report
text:
# Export a report
Since 2.3.0, every report can be exported as CSV, XLSX, or PDF from the same report view.
Before 2.3.0, reports exported to PDF and CSV only.

title: Schedule report emails
text:
# Schedule report emails
Saved reports can be emailed to stakeholders on a recurring basis: daily, weekly, or monthly.
Open a saved report and click Schedule. Add recipients, including people outside your organization.
> Note: Scheduled report emails are available on Professional and Enterprise.

title: Standard reports
text:
# Standard reports
InvoicePilot includes standard reports on every plan:
- Profit and Loss
- Balance Sheet
- Cash Flow
- Aged Receivables
- Sales by Customer
- Expenses by Category
- Customer Balance
- Tax Summary

title: Tax summary report
text:
# Tax summary report
Shows tax collected on invoices and tax paid on expenses for a date range, by tax rate.
Archived tax rates still appear for the periods they were used.

title: Contact support
text:
# Contact support
| Plan | Channels | First response target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Starter | Email | 2 business days |
| Professional | Email and chat | 1 business day |
| Enterprise | Priority email, chat, phone, named CSM | 4 hours |
Critical issues on Enterprise, such as a Critical-severity bug, are handled 24/7.

title: Frequently asked questions
text:
# Frequently asked questions
### Can I bill in more than one currency?
Yes, on every plan. Turn on multi-currency under Settings > Currencies.
### Do you support SSO?
Not today. See Single sign-on (SSO) and SAML.
### How do I add a tax rate?
Settings > Taxes > New Tax Rate.
### Can I get a custom invoice template?
Yes, on Professional and Enterprise. Starter includes 3 standard templates.
### Can I raise my API rate limit?
Limits are set by plan: 60, 300, or 1,000 requests per minute. Enterprise customers can ask about a custom limit.
### Are added seats prorated?
No. Added seats are billed at the full per-seat price and start their own 12-month term.
### How do I export statements for all customers?
There is no bulk statement export in the app. Use the Customer Balance report or API v2.

title: Glossary
text:

| Recurring profile | The schedule behind a recurring invoice |

Open a ticket with the steps to reproduce, the version shown under Help > About, and any error code such as IP-4220.

title: InvoicePilot Release Notes v1.8.0 "Harbor"
text:
# InvoicePilot Release Notes v1.8.0 "Harbor"
InvoicePilot Classic adds late fees, CSV export, and faster reports.
## New Features
- Late fees: add a fixed or percentage fee to overdue invoices automatically.
- CSV export for invoices, payments, and expenses.
- Standard reports load up to 3x faster.
## Improvements
- Invoice emails can include a custom message.
- Expense categories can be renamed.
## Upgrade Notes
1.8.0 rolls out to all Classic organizations. Late fees are off by default; turn them on under Settings > Late Fees.

title: InvoicePilot Release Notes v1.9.0 "Lighthouse"
text:
# InvoicePilot Release Notes v1.9.0 "Lighthouse"
InvoicePilot Classic adds estimates and attachments. This is the last 1.x release.
## New Features
- Estimates: send a quote and convert it to an invoice.
- Attach files up to 10 MB to invoices.
- Two-step verification for sign-in.
## Improvements
- Late fees are now calculated on the subtotal, not the total.
- CSV exports always use commas.
## Fixed in This Release
BUG-1800-01 — CSV export uses semicolons as separators in some locales
Organizations with a German or French locale got CSV exports separated by semicolons instead of commas.
BUG-1800-02 — Late fees calculated on the tax amount
Late fees were calculated on the invoice total including tax instead of the subtotal, overcharging clients.
## Known Issues
| Bug ID | Severity | Status | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BUG-1900-01 | Medium | Won't Fix | Invoice emails with attachments larger than 5 MB were queued and could arrive up to 2 hours late. Superseded by the 2.0.0 email service. |
## Upgrade Notes
1.9.0 is the final Classic release. InvoicePilot 2.0.0 replaces Classic in 2025; Classic organizations will be moved to 2.0.0 automatically.

title: InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.0.0 "Nova"
text:
# InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.0.0 "Nova"
A redesigned core app with native multi-currency support.
## New Features
- Multi-currency invoicing: bill customers in their local currency with daily exchange-rate updates.
- New dashboard with at-a-glance revenue, outstanding invoices, and expense trends.
- Redesigned navigation and settings area for faster access to organization preferences.
## Improvements
- Invoice PDF rendering is now roughly 2x faster for accounts with custom templates.
- Search now covers invoice line-item descriptions, not just invoice numbers.
## Fixed in This Release
BUG-2000-02 — Dashboard fails to load for accounts with 500+ contacts
Large accounts saw a blank dashboard due to an unpaginated contacts query timing out.
## Upgrade Notes
Existing single-currency organizations are unaffected; multi-currency must be enabled explicitly under Settings > Currencies before it appears on new invoices.

title: InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.0.1 "Nova Patch 1"
text:
# InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.0.1 "Nova Patch 1"
Patch release: exchange-rate refresh and invoice numbering fixes.
## Improvements
- Exchange rates now refresh every day, including weekends.
- Deleting a draft no longer consumes an invoice number.
## Fixed in This Release
BUG-2000-03 — Exchange rates not refreshed on weekends
Daily exchange rates were not refreshed on Saturdays and Sundays, so weekend invoices used Friday's rate.
BUG-2000-04 — Invoice numbering skips a number after a draft is deleted
Deleting a draft invoice consumed its number, leaving a gap in the INV- sequence.
## Upgrade Notes
This is a patch release. It is rolled out automatically to all organizations on the 2.0.x line.

title: InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.1.0 "Solstice"
text:
# InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.1.0 "Solstice"
Automated recurring invoices and receipt scanning for expenses.
## New Features
- Recurring Invoices: schedule invoices to auto-generate and send on a daily, weekly, monthly, or custom cadence.
- Expense receipt scanning: snap a photo of a receipt and InvoicePilot extracts the vendor, date, and amount automatically.
- Client-level payment reminders with configurable send windows.
## Improvements
- Recurring invoice previews now show the next 3 scheduled send dates before you confirm.
- Expense categories can now be bulk-reassigned from the expenses list.
## Fixed in This Release
BUG-2000-01 — Currency rounding error on invoice totals
Invoices in JPY and other zero-decimal currencies rounded totals incorrectly, overcharging customers by up to 1 unit per line item.
## Known Issues
| Bug ID | Severity | Status | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BUG-2100-01 | Low | Won't Fix | OCR accuracy on handwritten receipts is below 40%; typed/printed receipts are unaffected. Documented as a known limitation. |
## Upgrade Notes
Recurring invoice schedules created in 2.1.0 are calculated in your organization's local timezone; see Known Issues below for a daylight-saving edge case.

title: InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.1.1 "Solstice Patch 1"
text:
# InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.1.1 "Solstice Patch 1"
Patch release: duplicate reminders and receipt rotation fixes.
## Improvements
- Payment reminders are sent once even when the send window crosses midnight.
- Receipt scanning detects landscape photos and rotates them correctly.
## Fixed in This Release
BUG-2100-03 — Receipt scanning rotates landscape receipts
Receipts photographed in landscape were rotated 90 degrees before OCR, so the amount was often missed.
BUG-2100-04 — Payment reminder sent twice when the send window crosses midnight
Client-level reminders with a send window that crossed midnight UTC were sent twice.
## Upgrade Notes
This is a patch release. It is rolled out automatically to all organizations on the 2.1.x line.

title: InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.2.0 "Meridian"
text:
# InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.2.0 "Meridian"
A redesigned client portal, bulk invoice actions, and API v2.
## New Features
- Client Portal 2.0: clients can view invoice history, download statements, and pay online from a single self-serve page.
- Bulk invoice actions: send, remind, or void up to 100 invoices at once from the invoice list.
- API v2 (REST): new endpoints for invoices, customers, and payments with cursor-based pagination.
## Improvements
- Client portal now supports organization branding (logo and accent color).
- API v1 remains available but is now considered legacy; new integrations should use v2.
## Fixed in This Release
BUG-2200-01 — Client portal login loop on Safari
Safari users were redirected back to the login page after successful authentication due to a cookie SameSite misconfiguration.
## Upgrade Notes
Existing client portal links continue to work without changes. API v1 integrations are not affected and do not need to migrate immediately.

title: InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.2.1 "Meridian Patch 1"
text:
# InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.2.1 "Meridian Patch 1"
Patch release: API v2 pagination and bulk void reminder fixes.
## Improvements
- API v2 list endpoints now return next_cursor: null on the last page.
- Voiding invoices in bulk now cancels their scheduled payment reminders.
- Expense CSV import accepts DD/MM/YYYY and YYYY-MM-DD dates.
## Fixed in This Release
BUG-2110-02 — Expense CSV import rejects DD/MM/YYYY dates
Importing expenses from CSV failed for files with dates written as DD/MM/YYYY.
BUG-2200-03 — Bulk void leaves payment reminders scheduled
Invoices voided with a bulk action kept their scheduled payment reminders, so clients got reminders for void invoices.
BUG-2200-04 — API v2 list endpoints return next_cursor on the last page
List endpoints returned a non-null next_cursor on the last page, so integrations made one extra empty request.
## Upgrade Notes
This is a patch release. It is rolled out automatically to all organizations on the 2.2.x line. No API changes are needed; integrations that stopped on an empty last page keep working.

title: InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.3.0 "Aurora"
text:
# InvoicePilot Release Notes v2.3.0 "Aurora"
Automatic bank-reconciliation matching and a custom report builder.
## New Features
- Bank Reconciliation auto-match: connected bank feeds are automatically matched against recorded invoices and expenses.
- Custom Report Builder: build and save reports by combining any combination of accounts, date ranges, and tags.
- Saved report schedules can now be emailed to stakeholders on a recurring basis.
## Improvements
- Bank feed sync frequency increased from once daily to every 4 hours.
- Report exports now support CSV, XLSX, and PDF from the same report view.
## Fixed in This Release
BUG-2200-02 — API v2 rate limit headers missing
API v2 responses did not include X-RateLimit-* headers, making it hard for integrators to back off proactively.
## Known Issues
| Bug ID | Severity | Status | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Auto-match runs automatically the first time you open Bank Reconciliation after upgrading; review suggested matches before confirming them in bulk.

title: ADR-009: Cursor pagination for API v2
author: platform-team
text:
# ADR-009: Cursor pagination for API v2

## Decision
v2 list endpoints use opaque cursors (next_cursor) with limit up to 100, instead of v1's ?page=&per_page=.

## Why
Page numbers skip or repeat rows when data changes between calls.

## Note
2.2.0 returned a cursor on the last page by mistake (BUG-2200-04); fixed in 2.2.1.

title: ADR-010: Idempotency keys for POST
author: platform-team
text:
# ADR-010: Idempotency keys for POST

## Decision
POST endpoints accept an Idempotency-Key header. We store the key with a hash of the body for 24 hours.

## Behavior
Same key and same body returns the stored response. Same key and a different body returns 409 IP-4090. A key whose first request is still running returns 409 IP-4091.

title: ADR-012: New PDF renderer
author: platform-team
text:
# ADR-012: New PDF renderer

## Decision
Replace the HTML-to-PDF service with a native renderer in 2.3.1 for speed.

## Risk noted

title: ADR-014: Calculate recurring schedules in UTC
author: platform-team
text:
# ADR-014: Calculate recurring schedules in UTC

## Decision
Store and calculate recurring schedules in UTC. Show them in the organization's local time.

## Why
Local wall-clock math broke twice a year at DST changes (BUG-2100-02).

## Consequences
Shipped in 2.3.1. The old help page about local-time schedules is stale and should be retired.

title: ADR-017: Per-key concurrency limit
author: platform-team
text:
# ADR-017: Per-key concurrency limit

## Decision
Limit each API key to 10 requests in flight, on every plan. Over the limit returns 429 IP-4291.

## Why
A few integrations ran 50+ parallel workers and caused slowdowns for everyone, while staying under their per-minute limit.

title: ADR-018: Webhook retry schedule
author: platform-team
text:
# ADR-018: Webhook retry schedule

## Decision
Retry failed webhook deliveries up to 8 times over 24 hours (was 5). Disable an endpoint after 3 days of failures.

## Why
5 retries over 6 hours missed weekend outages at small customers.

title: Note: auto-match tolerance
author: platform-team
text:
# Note: auto-match tolerance

Auto-match requires an exact amount match and a date within 7 days. We tried a 0.5% tolerance in beta and it caused false matches on recurring payments of similar size, so it was removed before 2.3.0.

author: platform-team
text:
# Postmortem INC-2025-031: Recurring invoices skipped across the DST change

**Incident:** INC-2025-031
**Bug:** BUG-2100-02 (High)
**Affected version:** 2.1.0
**Fixed in:** 2.3.1

## Impact
312 recurring profiles across 41 organizations missed one invoice.

## Root cause
Schedules were stored as local wall-clock times. On 2025-11-02 clocks went back one hour in the US, and the scheduler's 'next run' calculation landed in a time that it had already passed, so 312 profiles skipped one cycle.

## Resolution
Short term: support re-sent missed invoices by hand. Long term: ADR-014 moves schedule math to UTC. Shipped in 2.3.1.

## Customer communication
Support linked affected tickets to BUG-2100-02. Customers get an email when the fix ships.

author: platform-team
text:
# Postmortem INC-2026-011: Duplicate payments from API retries

**Incident:** INC-2026-011
**Bug:** BUG-2210-02 (High)
**Affected version:** 2.2.1
**Fixed in:** 2.3.0

## Impact
214 duplicate payments across 9 API customers.

## Root cause
A refactor of the payments service in 2.2.1 moved the payment write before the idempotency check. Retries with the same Idempotency-Key created a second payment.

## Resolution
Restored the check order and added a test for every POST endpoint. Fixed in 2.3.0. A script found and listed 214 duplicate payments for support.

## Customer communication
Support linked affected tickets to BUG-2210-02. Customers get an email when the fix ships.

title: Postmortem INC-2026-016: Bank feed provider outage
author: platform-team
text:
# Postmortem INC-2026-016: Bank feed provider outage

**Incident:** INC-2026-016
**Date:** 2026-06-01, 08:05 to 11:40 UTC

## Impact
Bank feed sync failed for US accounts using our main aggregator. API calls to bank endpoints returned HTTP 503 with IP-5030.

## Root cause
The aggregator had an outage. Our sync retried too fast and was throttled after they recovered.

## Resolution
Added jittered backoff to sync retries. IP-5030 is the correct code for this case and clients should retry with backoff.

title: Postmortem INC-2026-019: Auto-match fails on multi-currency accounts
author: platform-team
text:
# Postmortem INC-2026-019: Auto-match fails on multi-currency accounts

**Incident:** INC-2026-019
**Bug:** BUG-2310-01 (Critical)
**Affected version:** 2.3.1
**Fixed in:** not yet fixed

## Impact
Every organization with a foreign-currency bank account on 2.3.1. Critical severity.

## Root cause
In 2.3.1 the matching service was moved to a new amount comparator that skips the currency conversion step. Foreign-currency transactions are compared in their own currency against base-currency invoices.

## Resolution
Workaround published: manual matching for foreign-currency transactions. The fix needs the comparator to load daily rates; see the planning note.

## Customer communication
Support linked affected tickets to BUG-2310-01. Customers get an email when the fix ships.

text:

title: Pitching the API to technical buyers

text:

- REST API v2 with cursor pagination and JSON error codes like IP-4220

title: Battlecard: InvoicePilot vs BillBright
author: product-marketing
text:
# Battlecard: InvoicePilot vs BillBright
## Who they are
BillBright: Invoicing app for freelancers.
## Where they're strong
Very simple, cheap single-user plan.
## Where they're weak
No bank reconciliation auto-match, no custom reports.
## How we win
- Bank feeds with auto-match (2.3.0+)
- Custom report builder
- Bulk actions on up to 100 invoices

text:
# Objection handling
### "We need SSO."
SAML SSO isn't available. Don't give a date. Offer two-step verification and the security overview.
### "Your API is rate limited."
Enterprise gets 1,000 requests per minute and can ask for a custom limit. Webhooks remove most polling.
### "We heard about bugs in 2.3.1."
Be honest: BUG-2310-01 and BUG-2310-02 are open with workarounds. Don't promise a fix date.

Starter has every feature; plans differ by limits. Show the plan comparison.
### "Can we pay monthly?"
Seats are billed per year. There's no monthly billing.
